_comment: Attribute defaults for contrib operators, which the onnx package has no
schema for. analyze_conversion.py uses them the same way it uses the
ai.onnx schema defaults: an attribute the conversion dropped is only a
partial-support finding when its value differs from the default, because
dropping a default changes no behaviour.
Values follow the ONNX Runtime contrib operator specification. An
attribute missing from this table is always treated as a real drop, so
the table can only reduce false partials, never hide a real one.
